test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The retail price of a water geyser is ₹11,300. If the manufacturer gains 5%, the wholesale dealer gains 10% and the retailer gains 15%, then find the cost price of the water geyser (rounded off to two decimal places.)

(Note: Manufacturer sells to wholesaler, wholesaler sells to retailer and retailer sells to customer.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **Cost Price (CP)** of the manufacturer be x.

Successive selling price chain: x × 105/100 × 110/100 × 115/100 = 11,300.

x × 1.05 × 1.10 × 1.15 = 11,300.

x × 1.32825 = 11,300.

x = 11,300 ÷ 1.32825 = 8,507.4346...

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,507.43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → **Retail Price** = ₹11,300 | **Manufacturer Profit** = 5% | **Wholesaler Profit** = 10% | **Retailer Profit** = 15%.
Formulas: SP = CP × (100 + P%)/100 | Final Price = Initial CP × (1 + r₁/100) × (1 + r₂/100) × (1 + r₃/100).
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dd404f5a04d1b0eb2d33e1bb8d5bcad0eb92fe9f91d7db94eae65190af63bea.png] 
⇒ Let initial CP be CP.
⇒ Price after Manufacturer = CP × 1.05.
⇒ Price after Wholesaler = (CP × 1.05) × 1.10.
⇒ Price after Retailer = (CP × 1.05 × 1.10) × 1.15 = 11,300.
⇒ CP × 1.32825 = 11,300.
⇒ CP = 11,300 ÷ 1.32825 = 8,507.434...
**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,507.43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Changes

When a value is increased by x%, y%, and z% successively, the final value is Initial × (1 + x/100) × (1 + y/100) × (1 + z/100).

Retailer and Customer

The **Selling Price** of one entity in the supply chain becomes the **Cost Price** for the next entity.
